purpose: Platform-enforced trusted runner isolation for the real-VFP9 acceptance lane. This file is a REQUIRED-CONFIGURATION SPECIFICATION, NOT evidence: it does not prove that GitHub is configured this way. Objective proof can only come from verifying the live GitHub runner-group configuration (GitHub REST API / organization settings) plus a real dispatched workflow run on protected main.
external_blocker: The repository is public and user-owned. GitHub runner groups (the platform mechanism that can restrict runner access to selected repositories AND selected workflows) exist only at organization/enterprise level. Until the ownership/topology decision provides such a group, a platform-enforced trusted runner boundary cannot be configured, and no repository-level runner may be registered as a workaround (official GitHub guidance: self-hosted runners should almost never be used with public repositories, because any fork can open a pull request that executes code on the runner).

layer_1_platform_authorization.group_membership: self-hosted Windows runner dedicated to Visual FoxPro 9 acceptance

repository_access.owner_placeholder_note: FINAL_OWNER is deliberately unset until the repository ownership/topology decision is made; it must not be guessed.
repository_access.default_scope_note: By default private repositories only can access a runner group; public access must be granted explicitly and deliberately.

workflow_access.equivalent_platform_isolation: acceptable only if it provably prevents every other workflow file - including future PR-modified files - from scheduling jobs on the trusted runner

layer_1_platform_authorization.verification_procedure: After provisioning, verify through GitHub configuration APIs/settings (runner group exists; repository allowlist == the single DBF_Anonymizer repository; workflow allowlist exactly the trusted workflow pinned to refs/heads/main) and only then dispatch the trusted workflow on protected main to produce execution evidence.

layer_2_workflow_defense_in_depth.ref_guard: refs/heads/main only, verified before any checkout
layer_2_workflow_defense_in_depth.checkout: no explicit ref and no caller-provided SHA/branch; never github.event.pull_request.head.sha
layer_2_workflow_defense_in_depth.revision_identity: git rev-parse HEAD must equal origin/main and be recorded with the sanitized evidence
layer_2_workflow_defense_in_depth.acceptance_tool: tools/run_real_vfp9_acceptance.py (the established REQ-P6-003 boundary; no second acceptance protocol)

runner_targeting.syntax: runs-on mapping with group and labels
runner_targeting.fail_closed: while either variable is unset the job cannot be scheduled and the lane produces no evidence

layer_2_workflow_defense_in_depth.environment_approvals: NOT a substitute for the runner-group boundary (an attacker-controlled workflow could omit the environment)

acceptance_requires_all_of: platform-level runner access isolation (runner group allowlisting only this repository)
workflow access restricted to the dedicated trusted VFP workflow
trusted workflow pinned to protected main
runner-group policy verified from live GitHub configuration
a real workflow_dispatch run on protected main
record count / tag inventory proved per accepted P6-003 evidence
no untrusted PR code executed on the trusted machine
until_then: REQ-P7-006 remains PARTIAL/BLOCKED; the hosted/public gates remain the only green evidence; do NOT register a repository-level self-hosted runner; do NOT merge while the trusted-VFP execution evidence is missing.
